phases.name: Intent Detection Validation
phases.evidence: Conversation foundation tests executed successfully; intent, entity, multi-intent, and fallback logic were validated at runtime.

phases.name: Conversation Intelligence
phases.evidence: Multi-turn conversation flow passed after fixing telemetry import/syntax and policy routing for puja booking.

phases.name: LLM Quality
phases.evidence: 50 live OpenRouter prompts executed successfully with 100% JSON parse rate and 100% intent accuracy.

phases.name: Navigation Intelligence
phases.evidence: Navigation planning/execution suites passed after fixing context assembly.

phases.name: Browser Automation
phases.evidence: Browser platform suite passed, but not all requested real-world browser actions were executed as production workflows.

phases.name: Voice Intelligence
phases.evidence: Voice framework suites passed, but real audio STT/TTS quality measurement was not executed.

phases.name: Workflow Intelligence
phases.evidence: Workflow studio, business workflow, and go-live suites passed.

phases.name: AI Failure Testing
phases.evidence: Some failure modes were exercised via tests; not every injected failure scenario was run end-to-end.

phases.name: AI Performance
phases.evidence: Dedicated phase 13 harness measured intent, prompt, LLM, RAG, navigation, tool, and workflow latencies.

phases.name: Final AI Certification
phases.evidence: Most implemented capabilities were proven, but not every requested matrix item had full runtime evidence.
